description: Final integration, polish, and service worker update. Ensure all features work together, navigation is consistent, service worker caches new assets, and the app feels cohesive.
steps: 1. Update sw.js STATIC_ASSETS array to include any new JS files (e.g., js/data.js if created). Add the Aladhan API domain to the fetch handler for network-first caching (similar to how equran.id is handled).
2. Update manifest.json description to reflect the expanded app features.

3. Verify and fix any navigation inconsistencies: Ensure back buttons on sub-pages navigate to #more (not just #home). Ensure the More nav item shows as active when on any sub-page accessed from More.
4. Add smooth transitions between pages. Ensure all new pages have proper header styling consistent with existing pages (use .simple-header pattern from bookmark/settings pages).
5. Test dark mode toggle affects all new pages correctly - verify CSS variables are used consistently throughout all new styles.
6. Add a brief 'about' or version update in the Settings page mentioning the new features (update version to v2.0).
7. Ensure the home page header subtitle reflects the expanded app: change from 'Al-Quran Digital dengan Terjemahan' to something like 'Al-Quran & Ibadah Digital'.
acceptance_criteria: Service worker caches all new static assets
Aladhan API responses are cached with network-first strategy
Dark mode works consistently across all pages
Navigation between all pages is smooth and consistent
Back buttons work correctly from all sub-pages
No console errors when navigating through all pages
verification: Run a local HTTP server and verify service worker registers without errors
Toggle dark mode and navigate through all pages to verify theming
Navigate forward and backward through all feature pages
Check browser console for any JavaScript errors during full navigation flow
